title: Request Intake
description: Legacy payload of POST /api/intake/requests. The endpoint is deprecated and now creates a SupportRequest bound to a SupportSource; it never creates an issue. Authenticated with the X-Intake-Token header (TRIBE_INTAKE_TOKEN), not with a user session. New integrations should use POST /api/communities/{community_id}/support/requests.

workspace_id.description: Deprecated and ignored. Kept so old callers keep validating.

title.description: Short human title; long requests are trimmed by the caller.

issue_type.description: Deprecated and ignored. The legacy endpoint no longer creates issues.

source.description: Where the request came from. `source.source_id` selects a SupportSource directly; otherwise `source.app` is matched against SupportSource.app_id. `external_id` makes retries idempotent per source.

app.description: Client app id, e.g. video_review. Matched against SupportSource.app_id.

url.description: Page the request was filed from.

external_id.description: Caller-side request id. Repeated submissions with the same source return the first SupportRequest instead of creating another.

browser_logs.description: JSON string with the client log snapshot; truncated server-side to TRIBE_INTAKE_MAX_LOGS_CHARS.

requester.description: Who filed the request. All fields are optional. The SupportRequest author is `requester.account_id` when present, otherwise intake:<app>.
